description.value: Describes itself as an open observability platform that helps teams connect disparate data so they can act faster.
Offers Grafana Cloud, which it describes as an open observability platform for full-stack monitoring, built on open standards such as OpenTelemetry and Prometheus.
A private observability company that builds open-source and cloud-based tools, with Grafana Cloud as its best-known offering.

product_description.value: Grafana Cloud, a managed observability platform covering logs, metrics, traces and profiles, dashboards, Kubernetes and application monitoring, synthetic monitoring, k6 performance testing and incident response; AI tools include Grafana Assistant, AI Investigations and Agent Observability.
Grafana Cloud, a fully managed observability platform; open-source projects including Loki, Mimir, Tempo, k6, Pyroscope, Faro, Beyla and Alloy; and the Grafana Assistant AI product.
Grafana Cloud, a managed service with hosted Grafana and telemetry services, and Grafana Enterprise, a self-managed offering with features such as LDAP team sync and reporting.
Grafana Cloud (managed hosted service with telemetry and AI-assisted tools) and Grafana Enterprise (self-managed); related products include the LGTM stack, Alloy, Beyla, Faro and k6.
Grafana Cloud managed platform for dashboards, Kubernetes and application monitoring, synthetic testing and incident management; open-source projects include Grafana OSS, Loki, Mimir and Tempo.

business_model_description.value: Grafana is AGPLv3-licensed open source; Grafana Labs provides two commercial offerings, Grafana Cloud (managed) and Grafana Enterprise (self-managed).
A Free Forever tier, paid Cloud plans with a pricing page, and an open source component.
Freemium, open-source-led model; revenue comes mainly from Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise Stack, with usage-based pricing on active users, metrics volume, and log and trace ingestion.

customer_description.value: Trusted by over 10,000 customers, from startups to enterprises.
More than 10,000 paying customers as of 2026, including Nvidia, Anthropic and Uber; also used by Wikimedia's infrastructure, NASA and the Tour de France.
Logos include Microsoft, NVIDIA, Salesforce, BlackRock, Canva, DHL, Anthropic, Bloomberg, Pegasystems, Lovable, LATAM Airlines and Delivery Hero.
More than 10,000 paying customers as of 2026, including Nvidia, Anthropic and Uber.
Spans startups to large enterprises; main users are DevOps, SRE and platform teams; named customers include Salesforce, Bloomberg and J.P. Morgan Chase.
